s232_scope_n16_a_B.label: Matches U.S. note 16(a)_B
s232_scope_n16_a_B.description: (B) nails, tacks (other than thumb tacks), drawing pins, corrugated nails, staples (other than those of heading 8305) and similar articles, of iron or steel, whether or not with heads of other material (excluding such articles with heads of copper), of one piece construction, whether or not made of round wire; the foregoing described in statistical reporting numbers 7317.00.5503, 7317.00.5505, 7317.00.5507, 7317.00.5560, 7317.00.5580 or 7317.00.6560 only and not in other statistical reporting numbers of subheadings 7317.00.55 and 7317.00.65)

steel_melted_poured_us_mexico_canada.label: Steel melted and poured in the US, Mexico or Canada

ukraine_steel_certificate_of_origin.label: Required Ukrainian steel certificate of origin supplied

s232_scope_n16_a_C.label: Matches U.S. note 16(a)_C
s232_scope_n16_a_C.description: (C) bumper stampings of steel, the foregoing comprising parts and accessories of the motor vehicles of headings 8701 to 8705 (described in subheading 8708.10.30); and

s232_scope_n19_a_E.label: Matches U.S. note 19(a)_E
s232_scope_n19_a_E.description: (E) bumper stampings of aluminum, the foregoing comprising parts and accessories of the motor vehicles of heading 8701 to 8705 (described in subheading 8708.10.30); and

aluminum_primary_smelted_or_cast_russia.label: Any primary aluminum smelted in Russia or article cast in Russia

privileged_ftz_before_20230410.label: Privileged foreign status before April 10, 2023 at 00:01 Eastern

aluminum_smelt_cast_china_russia_belarus.label: Primary/secondary smelt or most recent cast is China, Russia, Belarus or Iran

s232_steel_quota_allocated.label: CBP allocated quota to this entire entry line

steel_melted_poured_japan.label: Steel melted and poured in Japan

steel_melted_poured_uk.label: Steel melted and poured in United Kingdom

uk_steel_producer_trq_access.label: UK producer has TRQ access under the attestation requirements

steel_melted_poured_eu.label: Steel melted and poured in an EU member country

steel_melted_poured_ukraine.label: Steel melted and poured in Ukraine

s232_aluminum_quota_allocated.label: CBP allocated quota to this entire entry line
s232_aluminum_quota_allocated.description: Use the actual country/category and presentation date allocation. Split partially allocated lines; a modeled utilization share is not an allocation.

aluminum_primary_china_russia_belarus.label: Wrought aluminum contains primary aluminum from China, Russia or Belarus

aluminum_certificate_of_analysis.label: Required aluminum Certificate of Analysis or CBP-accepted information supplied

s232_scope_n19_b_castings.label: Matches U.S. note 19(b)_castings
s232_scope_n19_b_castings.description: castings and forgings of aluminum provided for in subheading 7616.99.51.
